}
dataset = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Function to calculate the claim percentages
def make_autopct(values):
    def my_autopct(pct):
        total = sum(values)
        val = int(round(pct*total/100.0))
        return ''{p:.2f}%  ({v:d})''.format(p=pct, v=val)
    return my_autopct

# Plot the pie chart
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.pie(dataset[''claim''], labels=dataset[''region''], autopct=make_autopct(dataset[''claim'']), startangle=90, textprops={''fontsize'': 16})
